practice_questions.question_text: Construct a 3NF schema for a therapy centre. Each client has ClientID, name and DOB. Each specialist has SpecialistID and name. marking_points.criterion: Separate CLIENT with its own key and attributes.
Separate SPECIALIST with its own key and attributes.

BOOKING references ROOM; descriptive client/specialist/room attributes are not duplicated in booking.
